actual_commands: /bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,240p' README.md; jq -r '.stack_frames[] as "'$f | [$f,.value] | @tsv'"' samples.jsonl | awk -F '\\t' '{s["'$1]+=$2; n[$1]++} END{for(k in s) print s[k],n[k],k}'"' | sort -nr | head -80"

/bin/bash -lc "jq -r 'select(.stack_frames[] == \"result:repeated\") | [.value, .labels.comparison_side[0], .labels.evidence_id[0], (.stack_frames[] | select(startswith(\"action:\") or startswith(\"strategy:\")))] | @tsv' samples.jsonl | awk -F '\\t' '{if("'$1>0){p+=$1; pn++; ps[$3]=1}else{n+=-$1; nn++; ns[$3]=1}; by[$4]+=$1} END{for(x in ps) pu++; for(x in ns) nu++; printf "candidate=%d base=%d net=%d candidate_tuples=%d base_tuples=%d candidate_evidence_ids=%d base_evidence_ids=%d'"\\n\",p,n,p-n,pn,nn,pu,nu; for(k in by) print by[k],k}' | sort -nr; jq -r 'select(.stack_frames[] == \"result:repeated\") | [.value, (.stack_frames[] | select(startswith(\"task:\")))] | @tsv' samples.jsonl | awk -F '\\t' '{s["'$2]+=$1; if($1>0)p[$2]=1; else n[$2]=1} END{for(k in s){if(s[k]>0)netpos++; if(p[k])pt++; if(n[k])nt++} print "candidate_tasks="pt,"base_tasks="nt,"net_positive_tasks="netpos}'"'"

/bin/bash -lc "jq -r '[.value, (if (.stack_frames[] == \"result:repeated\") then 1 else 0 end)] | @tsv' samples.jsonl | awk -F '\\t' '{if("'$1>0){allp+=$1;if($2)rp+=$1}else{alln+=-$1;if($2)rn+=-$1}} END{printf "candidate repeated=%d/%d (%.2f%%); base repeated=%d/%d (%.2f%%); rate_ratio=%.2fx'"\\n\",rp,allp,100*rp/allp,rn,alln,100*rn/alln,(rp/allp)/(rn/alln)}'"
